supported_findings.finding: Returns self.enabled and self.cpu_busy. These attributes initialized/updated as booleans; CPU flag means cached classification of user-visible registered work, not observed external CPU load.

Reads _RESOURCE_POLICY directly, returns False absent policy, otherwise bool(policy.pauses_animation()). It does not call policy factory, create a QApplication or create the policy. Factory may create an attached policy only when Qt exists; that is a separate operation.

_follow_the_run uses gil_priority.active() OR CPU-policy wrapper; _rate returns min(configured_fps,_RUN_FPS) when paced. This is a configured upper cap, not actual delivered rate, guaranteed motion or blanket stop. Policy Off does not disable independent GIL claim pacing.

_should_run separately tests requested animation, widget visibility, Reduce motion and window minimization; _sync_run_state follows cap before deciding start or stop. Neither helper evaluates those conditions.

blocks_gpu returns enabled AND(cpu_busy OR gpu_busy); GPU-only work does not turn CPU-helper True. _apply consults blocks_gpu and _hold_fractals selects live unpaused widgets for CPU flag OR GPU backend. Only successfully paused widgets are tracked for release. Predicate itself performs no GPU restriction or fractal hold.

Decorative engine consults _decorative_gpu_blocked before hardwareGPU work; independent graphics/backend and external compute-idle checks also exist. The drafts do not promise Off makes GPU unrestricted.

precise_refinement.suggested_whole_docstring:
Whether the enabled workload policy reports CPU-heavy work.

True means both :attr:`enabled` and :attr:`cpu_busy` are set. It is a
CPU-work policy flag, not a statement that every animation has stopped.
Backdrop callers use it to cap their configured rate at no more than
:data:`_RUN_FPS`; the policy also holds eligible Spaceout fractals.
GPU-only work does not set this flag. :meth:`blocks_gpu` reports the
separate decorative GPU restriction; the policy uses that decision
to hold eligible GPU-backed Spaceout fractals.

:returns: True only while this policy is enabled and CPU work is marked busy.
